Filing gate: **④ a coordination child.** This is a sub-issue of #27377, the v18.3.0 release test sweep anchor. Slices S1–S9 have landed (S9 #28641 closed). These 18 lines are what the retest W3-RT parked after them (anchor comment 6557904764, record #28656 at `6e11a929`). The anchor cannot close until they are in the ledger.
Business reason: these items are the release's retest evidence. Every stale step below costs the next runner a hand-walk or a false finding: knownGaps that say "FAILS TODAY" for fixed defects, guarded vitest invocations, recipes that 400 or 403, and routes and counts that moved.
Reader: any `domain:devx` seat, one PR, following #27164's shape: `revision` +1, history kept as a prefix, one row citing #28656, and `Part of #27377`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "wave-3 checklist accuracy slice" → S1–S9, all closed; none covers W3-RT's lines.
⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No product code.

## Scope

**Files:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`: studio-authoring (11), records-forms (2), integration-system (2), approvals (2), api-backend (1). No other file.

Re-verify each row against the current head before editing. A row that no longer holds is reported as fixed upstream. A clause is only made stronger or more precise, never weaker.

Row 2 depends on #27482's disposition. Edit only its factual half (the editor half is #27482, open; #27612, #27643 and #27644 landed). Leave acceptance[4]'s "no PUT issued" as it is until #27482 is ruled.

| # | item | clause | finding (W3-RT, verbatim) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `studio-authoring.expression-editors` | fixtures.knownGaps[3] | stale: says a non-lowerable RLS read predicate is warning-tier and autosaves (objectui#13061). Live at 6e11a929 it is error-tier, perm-autosave-held, 0 PUTs. Should drop the warning-tier gap |
| 2 | `studio-authoring.expression-editors` | fixtures.knownGaps[4] | stale: "the editor half has no open card". Should say the editor half is #27482 (open); #27612/#27643/#27644 landed; the residual is the first autosave of each newly refused text (formula-field USING). If the maintainer accepts that residual, acceptance[4]'s "no PUT issued" for that probe becomes "held from the server re-read on" |
| 3 | `studio-authoring.expression-editors` | fixtures.knownGaps[1], [2] / acceptance[7].verify | stale: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run` is refused by the ui vitest guard. Should say `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.test.ts` |
| 4 | `studio-authoring.expression-editors` | steps[3] | clarity: the completion listbox caps at 8 (MAX_CEL_SUGGESTIONS) and a bare `record.` lists system fields first. Should say to type a prefix (`record.est`, `previous.s`) |
| 5 | `studio-authoring.access-owd-and-suggestions` | fixtures.knownGaps[1] D10 | looks fixed: after the OWD 422 and an undo the panel reads "No changes" with no banner (pin PackageOwdOverviewPanel.refusalClearsOnRevert-26846). Should drop D10 or re-measure; D13 still holds, also at the API (409 SUGGESTION_STATE) |
| 6 | `studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard` | steps[7] | missing: the item draft read GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?state=draft&package=PKG answers 404 when no draft exists. Should say a 404 before and after Leave is the "unchanged" reading |
| 7 | `studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` | fixtures.knownGaps[0] | stale: "acceptance[4] FAILS TODAY". #27459 (PR #27784) holds; acceptance[4] passes at 6e11a929. Should drop it (the report-panel half is #27785) |
| 8 | `studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` | acceptance[4].verify | ambiguous: "after a reload, the other edits are present". Should say edits before Add item survive a reload; an edit made while held lands in the PUT that completes the item; a reload while held raises beforeunload and Leave discards by design |
| 9 | `studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` | steps[4] / steps[2] | missing: a text global filter commits only on Enter or blur (DashboardFilterBar.tsx); "leave one widget unbound" means filterBindings false for every filter (a widget with no filterBindings inherits filters on its own field — source read, not tested live) |
| 10 | `studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring` | fixtures.knownGaps[0] / negative[0] | stale: "acceptance[0] AND [1] FAIL TODAY". Fixed by #27461 (PR #27720), both pass at 6e11a929. Should re-word negative[0] as a plain FAIL condition |
| 11 | `studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties` | steps[0] | missing: use a same-origin logo (e.g. /_console/vite.svg); an external logo URL is blocked by the container egress proxy and never renders |
| 12 | `records-forms.field-history-tracking` | steps[3] | stale since objectstack#28469: "no width draws a tab strip". The record page now draws Overview · Activity · panels at 1440/1000/700 px. Should say open the stream from the Activity tab, the 动态 panel header, or ?related=timeline; acceptance[2] unaffected |
| 13 | `records-forms.field-history-tracking` | automated.ref | missing: record-history-display.spec.ts runs only against the vite console (LIVE_APP_URL, default :5180), not a built /_console boot. Should name that requirement |
| 14 | `integration-system.email-template-render` | fixtures.knownGaps[1] | incomplete recipe: the notify node must not carry inline title/message beside template (400); type 'autolaunched' is refused at POST /automation/NAME/trigger (403); type 'api' needs config.secret or secretRef (400). Should spell a type:'api' flow with {triggerType:'api', hookId, secret}, a notify node with channels ['email'], template, templateData, fired as admin |
| 15 | `integration-system.email-template-render` | steps[7] | stale: under os dev's default watcher a declared-source save recompiles AND restarts the server. Should say compile into the running copy's dist/objectstack.json (objectstack compile --output) or boot with --no-restart, and confirm the listener PID is unchanged |
| 16 | `approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` | steps[4] | missing: the approvals route's wire key is `outputs` ({"outputs":{"next_reviewers":[…]}}; the action door's params use `outputs.next_reviewers`). Should name it so a refusal is attributable |
| 17 | `api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix` | acceptance[5] / steps[6] | precision: the single-item POST /api/v1/meta/object/NAME/publish also refuses (422 INVALID_METADATA, same expression-invalid). Should name both promotion doors |
| 18 | `approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` | carried line 6539452860 | CLOSED: acceptance[3] snapshot leg read live at 6e11a929; key spelling accurate; retire the line |

## Done when

All 18 rows are edited or reported as fixed upstream. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green. The PR lands.
